Are you an experienced Technical Recruiter who knows the ins and outs of IT sourcing, tech-stack screening, and talent acquisition? Parangat Technologies is actively looking for high-energy recruiters to drive our IT hiring pipeline!

💰 Salary: Decent & Competitive (Based on experience and skill set)
⚡ Joining: Immediate / Notice period within 10 days
🏢 Company: Parangat Technologies
💻 Key Responsibilities (IT Recruitment Focus)
End-to-end recruitment lifecycle for niche IT roles (Full Stack, Mobile App Developers, DevOps, Cloud Engineers, AI/ML Specialists).
Sourcing active & passive tech talent via LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, StackOverflow, and boolean search strings.
Technical screening and assessing candidates on software stacks, frameworks, and project portfolios.
